body.message:
Unfortunately, the check-out date is scheduled for 2nd August, as the bookings are calculated based on a 30-night stay cycle. For months with 31 days, the extension dates may vary accordingly based on the 30-night calculation.

We completely understand your situation and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. However, we are unable to provide an additional 2-day extension without the required payment, as we must have the payment confirmation in order to extend and secure the booking.

We truly appreciate your understanding and cooperation, and we will be happy to assist you with the extension once the payment is completed.
